script: David Beckham paid twenty-five million dollars for the right to start an MLS team. That team is Inter Miami, and today it's worth one point four five billion. Sportico now ranks Miami as the most valuable club in MLS for the first time, just ahead of LAFC. Its value jumped twenty-two percent in one year, the biggest jump in the league. Five MLS clubs are now worth more than a billion dollars. Is Inter Miami worth it? Tell us in the comments.
